admission.justification: Replacing the request's deny list could silently re-enable tools that the user forbade.

applicability: The supported per-agent Claude create request and its pinned host merge.
conditions: Repeat existing host option-level denied tools before adding the product's exact rule.
Do not change user, folder or harness configuration.
exclusions: Rules added to host options after the original launch do not retroactively alter its saved request.
The host's separate runtime deny list retains its independent behavior.

evidence: mcp/tests/test_role_single_server.py::SingleServerTests::test_what_the_host_s_configuration_denies_stays_denied; notes/reports/worker/a4868b83-d390-4b5e-9761-5097bcca689d/role-launch/repair-r1/f05/run.txt (the pinned host's own merge function); notes/reports/worker/a4868b83-d390-4b5e-9761-5097bcca689d/role-launch/260928-MIK-L113-repair-of-round-1-attempt-A2-37.md, section 2

statement: What keeps the other server out is handed to the host for that one agent as `providerOptions.disallowedTools` of the create request; no configuration file of the user, the folder or the harness is written, and the rules the host's own configuration denies for the provider are repeated in front of the product's rule so that they stay in force.
